novelty_rule: exclude any existing or already selected (sorted flop ranks, turn rank) signature irrespective of suits; selection cannot use tree size, policy, score or reference output

candidate.traversal: full expected target passes; RNG state unchanged

shared_training.crossing: first complete iteration at or above label

path_order: for each stratum: B4 seeds in order, then candidate
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 divided by initial pot, final linear average, lower better
report: all three dependent candidate-minus-B4 contrasts per spot and checkpoint
wall time, peak RSS and hardware
control-only top-three additive best-response nodes per street and same candidate nodes with cards/actions/reach/values

decision.positive: all candidate absolute gates pass; medium/dry paired median <= -0.001; low/wet paired median <= +0.001 initial pots
decision.negative: any candidate absolute gate fails; medium/dry paired median >= +0.001; or low/wet paired median > +0.001

profile.clock: context through capture, own scoring and replay
profile.estimate: maximum of three whole_path_seconds * 10000000/actual_final_node_work for each path
profile.T: maximum fixed-worker sum of path maxima

publication: prospective protocol before selection; cohort freeze before outcomes; qualified source before proof; proof before profile; published profile and separate admission before own; own before reference; final exact-source checks
